info.title: Tagloom Local Automation API
info.description: Local client workspace API. Authentication is explicit and grants expire on lock/session change. Each identity is limited to 120 requests/minute. JSON request bodies are limited to 1 MiB. Confirmation previews and result caches expire after 10 minutes; at most 128 grants and 256 retained calls. Versioned under /v1; incompatible contracts require a new version. No public network listener, remote AI or HTTP MCP transport. Long-lived clients send X-Tagloom-Session-Id; session binding is checked atomically with the call. Completed tool failures use result.succeeded=false with stable errorCode; property_readonly, property_value_invalid and schema_changed require the caller to revise its proposal.

bearerAuth.description: Owner token for administration; separate session-scoped Agent tokens for tools.

requestId.description: Optional idempotency key per principal and unlock session. Results retained for at most 10 minutes.

details.description: Included only in owner approval listings.

payload.description: Tool-specific structured output; collections expose items, hasMore, nextOffset.

token.description: One-time secret response; never send the owner token to an Agent.

Note.description: Canonical core Note payload. RichText and attributes are validated by the domain. Full replacement preserves all fields; Markdown replacement replaces blocks and annotations.

WorkspaceSession.name: X-Tagloom-Session-Id
WorkspaceSession.description: Optional unlock session binding. Required for long-lived clients; a changed session returns 423 session_changed.
